title: Keto-Friendly Gooey Korean Prawns Stew
description: A pungent, gooey, sick-day Polish dish featuring raw king prawns, made with a keto-friendly twist, all cooked to perfection in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot.
instructions: Heat the Low-Carb Sesame Oil in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
Add the raw king prawns and cook until pink, about 2 minutes per side.
Remove the prawns from the pot and set aside.
Add the Pork Belly Fat or Bacon and cook until crispy, about 3 minutes.
Add the Korean Chili Flakes, Gochujang, Fish Sauce, Scallions, Garlic, Pork Belly Fat or Bacon, Soy Sauce, Korean Chili Paste, and Keto-Friendly Korean Chili Powder to the pot.
Stir to combine and cook for 2 minutes.
Return the cooked prawns to the pot and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the prawns are coated in the spicy sauce.
Garnish with Cilantro and serve hot.
Let the stew cool to room temperature before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
When reheating, add the low-carb Sesame Oil and stir to combine.
